reviews.author: GeonyoungLim
reviews.text:
I visited the select shop ‘MECLADS’ located in Hannam-dong.

I discovered this place a few years ago while looking for F/CE backpacks and Marcel Derby, and when I visited it in person, I could see why this space felt like a ‘secret base known only to those in the know.’

The exterior is impressive with circular lighting and understated English fonts, and inside the store, wood and deep tone colors combine to create a calm and dense atmosphere.

It is not just a sales space, but more of a space where you can quietly experience the brand's world view.

Select is very powerful.

We are currently carrying out a balanced selection of highly sensitive brands in the fashion market, including Hed Mayner, Martine Rose, Ten-C, Studio Nicholson, GUIDI, Marsèll, Jan-Jan Van Essche, and mfpen.

The shoe lineup is especially impressive.

You can check out craftsmanship-based brands such as GUIDI, Marsèll, and Virtuoso Tau.H.

In addition, since it includes not only clothing but also living items, the aesthetics of the entire space are maintained well.

What impressed me most was the manager's detailed response and explanation.

Rather than selling a product, I was impressed by the fact that he calmly explained the background and value of the brand from the consumer's perspective.

This is a space I would like to recommend to those who are looking for a brand with direction and density, rather than a quickly consumed trend.

reviews.author: SJ Yang
reviews.text:
Update 11/2021: Every time I go, I am impressed by the kindness and explanation of the CEO and staff. It was really easy to talk to him because he knew not only the identity of all products and brands, but also the product's uniqueness and fit, and he also knew exactly the differences between seasonal items. I think this is the charm of a differentiated editing shop. In today's world, it is difficult to find the internal workmanship that cannot be found in other shops and the explanations and intentions of maniacal brands, but this place is different.

If you want brands that are rarely seen in Korea and a place where you can know exactly about those brands and hear product explanations, you should definitely come here. High quality conversation is just a bonus.

This shop is the kind of shop that people everywhere go to.

2020: Amazing curation with a neat selection of brands that you normally won’t find elsewhere. Their interior is on point as well as the bamboo floating racks.

reviews.text:
Date of visit: Spring 2024
Hunger index: 4

The moment I entered, I was met with unfriendly staff who made me feel sorry for the person who came.

To be honest, when a customer comes, it's not good for the boss or an employee who receives a fixed salary, so I don't understand how annoying it can be, but I didn't do anything serious while eating, and I just entered the restaurant, so it's not like being rude, and it's not even in France.

Yanggomtang
It costs 15,000 won, but honestly, I don’t know the advantages of Yangpyeong Haejangguk, which sells for 10,000 won.
It's not as spicy as it looks and it doesn't feel like there's a lot of it.

Basic side dish
One of the virtues of a seolleongtang restaurant is kimchi and radish radish kimchi.
The kimchi feels like they used too much ingredients and the radish radish radish is ordinary.

Summary: Food taste average, price expensive, staff unfriendly, kimchi + radish radish radish

Intention to revisit: Absolutely none.

reviews.author: Pure
reviews.text:
I want to have a leisurely meal in the morning, but the employees are laughing and talking, and I don't want to go there again. A side dish jar came with scissors and tongs, and I cut the kimchi and radish inside it and placed the tongs and scissors on the small bowl that came with it. A female waiter came and told me that I was eating it in a small bowl, and then asked if I could eat the whole side dish. It was really amazing. No, in the Corona era, do you mean to say that the side dishes served to guests are eaten and the leftover food is used again?? If you only give two side dishes...all your breath and breath will go into the side dishes provided...it would be nice to say, "Please mix it with the kimchi in a small bowl and eat it" while serving the side dishes and rice.
To be honest, the kimchi didn't look fresh because it had been a long time since it was prepared, but it tasted good after being bundled. It reminds me of the saying that you can repay a thousand debts with just one word. Just speaking well will benefit you. I said it myself so as not to offend (I would have been offended... maybe ㅠㅠ), but this is a store that really desperately needs customer service training for its employees. These days, even small coffee shops are good at serving customers, but it's a shame that they don't know that if the quality of the staff is poor, the taste of the food will disappear before you even eat it. The taste of dried pollack soup was too average... the customer service was poor, even though it was breakfast, the kimchi was dried out because it was old... honestly, not even a star is worth it, but the kimchi was delicious and I gave it 2 stars because I was thankful that it was open and satisfied my needs at such an early hour when other restaurants were not open.
ah! Even these days, rice is served like this. It's as if it was cooked with old-fashioned government rice... The taste of the rice is just so good... It's so delicious. These days, it's difficult to do this even with a regular home rice cooker. There is no stickiness at all, and of course there is no shine. It's crumbly...it's strange that it doesn't fall off. Is it just today or is it like this every day?

reviews.author: Chainsaw Cho
reviews.text:
This is a review after eating a plate of assorted pork belly at Daehakro Doebong Samgyeopsal. First of all, let's talk about the atmosphere of the store. It felt like I was really camping, perhaps because it was a camping concept. It was different and fun because it was decorated with camping equipment.

The plate of assorted pork ribs I ordered was grilled and easy to eat. Since the primed meat was brought to the table, I could eat it right away, so the waiting time was short, and the meat was cooked just right, so it was perfect. There were so many different types that I was able to enjoy several parts at once, including pork belly and pork neck. In particular, the pork belly was thick and juicy and very delicious. The neck meat was chewy and savory.

Also, the side dishes were plentiful and good to eat with the meat. In addition to the basic side dishes such as kimchi, garlic, ssamjang, and lettuce, there were special sauces that added even more flavor.

Overall, my experience at Doobong Samgyeopsal was very satisfactory. I especially liked being able to comfortably enjoy delicious meat in a unique atmosphere. It may be a little expensive, but it was a decent place.

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
I watched a video on YouTube introducing a cost-effective cold noodle restaurant, and the weather felt like it was gradually getting warmer, and I also like Hamheung cold noodles, so before it got hotter and there were more customers, I thought I would visit three of the four places mentioned in the video at once, excluding Cheongnyangni Grandma Naengmyeon, which I had been to before, and since it was Sunday, I called in advance to make sure they were open before leaving the house.

First, I headed to Grandma Naengmyeon Restaurant, located not far from my favorite store in Daehakro, Osso Pasta.

It was located slightly inside an alley, but I found it quickly by following the Naver map. There was no waiting line like you see at popular B-class cold noodle stores, and it felt quite leisurely once I entered the store.

Without looking at the menu in particular, I asked for bibim naengmyeon.

First, they brought me a pitcher and a cup filled with water, and after waiting for a while, the bibim naengmyeon came out with a slightly sweet pickled radish. The volume was average, but it was not like homemade noodles. After cutting the noodles appropriately, I mixed them well and tasted them. The noodles felt slightly heavy, reminiscent of the texture of rice cake, and were only moderately spicy. Among the B-grade naengmyeon restaurants, Cheongnyangni Grandma Naengmyeon, Jamsil Haeju Naengmyeon, or Bogwangdong are famous for their spicy cold noodles. It was an uncharacteristic spiciness, different from the spicy flavor of Donga Naengmyeon in Hannam-dong, which has its own charm, and when I looked at it on Naver Maps, it felt worse than the B-grade naengmyeon restaurants under 10,000 won, such as Honggane Myeonok in Yeongcheon Market, which seems to have closed down, or Eugene Restaurant in Nakwon-dong, which I recently visited.

As I was eating it, I like to eat bibim naengmyeon with warm broth, but I couldn't see any warm broth, so I asked for it, so they brought me a kettle and a cup with broth in it, and when I tasted it, I immediately felt sick.

The taste of the broth is not the MSG-spicy, pungent taste you expect from a B-grade cold noodle restaurant, but rather the taste of real seolleongtang broth, seasoned only slightly, as you would expect from a good seolleongtang restaurant. This situation explains the difference between the cold noodles, which don't seem to be special at all, and the warm broth, which feels special.

After consoling myself with the warm broth, I cleaned myself up and left Gagel, hoping that the next two stores I would visit would be better.

I stopped by because I thought it was a good hidden B-grade naengmyeon restaurant, but I didn't feel like I would visit again because I didn't feel anything special about the bibim naengmyeon seasoning or the noodles. However, the hot broth was of a high standard, so it was a surprising visit. If you're in Daehakro and craving high-quality cold noodles, it's worth a visit, but I felt it wasn't something I would stop by on purpose. It's not that it's not that bad, but the hot broth was good, so it was okay.
